issues: plan.experiment: 'ten replicates per film per trial' and 'real raspberries' are material feasibility claims; confirm FreshPak can supply this volume and that 'proxy produce' feasibility is evaluated.

plan.metrics: 'target go/no-go gate is mould incidence ≤1% at day 14 in all three simulated-transit replicates' assumes three replicates suffice for statistical confirmation; state this as a conditional hypothesis and clarify acceptance criterion (e.g., mean ≤1% or all three ≤1%).
plan.companyAsk: '50 technologist-hours total over 12 weeks' is 4 hours/week, contradicting '8 hours/week' stated earlier; reconcile resource commitment and confirm availability.

plan.researcherAsk: 'mentorship for one FreshPak technologist on gas-dynamics interpretation' and 'written interim report (week 8) and final report (week 12)' are deliverables; state as explicit conditional commitments, not assumed capabilities.

plan.dataRequired: 'recordId format and field names to be confirmed by FreshPak' leaves a material gap; specify data schema, access method, and timing before week 1 or defer to week 1 kick-off with go/no-go decision point.

plan.milestones: 'confirmatory in-house trial with real raspberries' at week 10–11 assumes berry availability; confirm source and lead time; 'mould scoring at days 7, 9, 11, 14' requires subjective rater calibration—state this as a protocol detail to be agreed.
plan.meeting: 'in-person or video' leaves travel/venue logistics unspecified; clarify default meeting mode and cost allocation (travel, venue).

plan.terms: 'no cash payments or grants are implied' contradicts 'FreshPak provides: ... technologist time (8 hours/week, approximately 50 technologist-hours total)'; clarify whether technologist cost is absorbed by FreshPak or co-funded; also clarify 'Month 4 post-pilot' timeline for industrial PhD negotiation and confirm Marković's institutional capacity to supervise.

Reduce plan prose by ~40% per criticFeedback; consolidate experiment, metrics, and milestones into compact sub-sections; move detailed timeline to appendix or separate project charter if length exceeds 600 words.

plan.experiment: 'three candidate films' not specified; cite which films or clarify selection criteria as go/no-go gate.

plan.experiment: 'eight days' trial duration stated without justification relative to target 14-day shelf-life outcome; explain why headspace equilibrium at day 8 predicts day-14 mould control or add day-14 confirmatory measurement.

plan.experiment: 'real raspberries versus proxy produce' deferred to week 1 without go/no-go threshold; specify minimum feasibility acceptance criterion (cost threshold, lead time, or cultivar availability) or trial becomes unexecutable if real fruit unavailable.
plan.metrics: 'acceptance criterion to be agreed' (all three ≤1% or mean ≤1%) is unresolved; propose specific criterion or mark as no-go if unbreakable disagreement anticipated.

plan.companyAsk: '8 hours/week assumed' contradicts stated 'three technologists' capacity; specify committed hours per technologist, total weekly allocation, and duration (8-week pilot or full 12 weeks), or risk schedule breach.
plan.companyAsk: 'lead rater to be identified' is unfulfilled prerequisite; confirm FreshPak has designated mould-scoring lead and assign name/contact or defer to mandatory week-1 checkpoint.
plan.researcherAsk: 'mentorship on gas-dynamics interpretation (scope and hours to be agreed)' is open-ended; propose bounded hours/week or remove from researcher commitment.

plan.dataRequired: 'CSV format; schema to be confirmed at week-1 kick-off or no-go checkpoint' defers critical data infrastructure to week 1; propose a provisional schema or minute 1 that data access failure triggers pilot cancellation.

plan.milestones: 'Go/no-go decision and follow-on partnership terms to be negotiated by month 4 post-pilot' conflates pilot completion (week 12) with partnership negotiation (week 16+); clarify whether week-12 report triggers automatic month-4 negotiation or conditional re-engagement after results review.
plan.risks: Uncertainty 1 addresses calibration drift but does not propose stop/accept thresholds for week-3 cross-check; specify tolerance (e.g., ±5% OTR drift) or action if exceeded.

plan.risks: Uncertainty 5 (rater bias) mitigation requires 'visual rating protocol by week 2' and calibration with FreshPak lead; confirm lead rater identity and protocol draft availability before week 1 or this gate cannot be closed.

plan.terms: '(4) Supervision: if industrial PhD pursued, Marković conditionally supervises one candidate' assumes post-pilot institutional capacity approval; clarify that this is contingent on Marković's current availability or risk offer of supervision that cannot be fulfilled.
